newsitem.title: UK: UK to suffer on interest rates with EMU - body says.
newsitem.headline: UK to suffer on interest rates with EMU - body says.

text.p: European monetary union (EMU) would would impose inappropriate levels of interest rates on the UK economy if Britain signs up, a leading business lobby said on Monday.

In a new paper, "The darker side of EMU", the Institute of Directors (IoD) said a European Central Bank would set interest rates to suit the EMU area as an average which would ordinarily be either too high or too low for Britain.
The paper was written in response to a recent paper published by the pro-EMU European Movement highlighting the benefits for Britain if it joins up.

The IoD said Britain's scope for fiscal manoeuvre would be constrained under EMU and said claims made by the European Movement that EMU would add up to half a point to UK growth rates were groundless.
"It is most unlikely that EMU would have more than a transitory effect on UK real interest rates, so it is hard to see that there could be a perceptible effect on the UK's growth rate," it said.
